_comment: LiteLLM 原版 model_prices_and_context_window.json 缺失、但旧价格镜像(price-mirror)中存在的模型。仅在上游没有该模型时补入，不会覆盖上游价格；上游补齐后本文件中的条目自动失效。以 _ 开头的键会被忽略。

glm-5._comment: BigModel China public API pricing converted at the Ccode fixed rate 1 USD = 6.7841 CNY. The provider lists cache storage as temporarily free; that time-limited storage promotion is not encoded as a permanent token price.

glm-5-turbo._comment: BigModel China public API pricing converted at the Ccode fixed rate 1 USD = 6.7841 CNY. The provider lists cache storage as temporarily free; that time-limited storage promotion is not encoded as a permanent token price.

grok-4.5._comment: Per docs.x.ai/developers/models/grok-4.5: <200k $2.00 / cached $0.30 / $6.00; >=200k $4.00 / $0.60 / $12.00. 'Requests whose prompt reaches 200k tokens are billed at the higher rate for all tokens in the request.' (xAI moves to the higher tier as soon as the threshold is reached.) The three above_200k fields match LiteLLM's xai/grok-* entries; LiteLLM has no bare key of this name, so they are never absorbed automatically.
